guardrails: none: no citation gate, no critic, fix not forced to need approval
rationale: checkoutservice has by far the largest latency jump (p50 +1761%, z=+117; p90 +1943%) while its callee paymentservice latency barely moves (p90 0.007s to 0.027s) and its workload drops ~62%, so the slowness is inside checkoutservice rather than downstream. Its socket count (+33%, z=+6.7) and memory (+31%) are the only resource anomalies, with CPU not implicated; socket is the best fit but the evidence is indirect, and memory is a plausible alternative.

proposed_fix.description: Restart or roll the checkoutservice pods to clear leaked sockets/connections, then inspect connection pooling and keep-alive settings for its calls to payment, email, currency and productcatalog services.
